loadServerDom.summary: Installs the server DOM: the globals HTMLElement and customElements the modules of the components need on the server.
loadServerDom.description:
A component extends HTMLElement, and @WebComponent defines it in customElements, as soon as their modules are evaluated: Node has neither. loadServerDom() installs the ones of the server DOM, which hold the attributes, the classes and the shadow root of an element without rendering anything. A global already there, such as the one of a browser or of a DOM emulated by the tests, is kept.

It must run before the modules of @xaendar/core and of the components are evaluated: the entry of the server calls it right after loadSignals(), and imports them afterwards, with import(). A static import is evaluated before the code of the module, wherever it is written.

The server DOM has no document and no window: the code of a component reading them in its constructor, in a field initializer or in onInit throws on the server, unless it checks typeof first. A class defined again with the tag and the name of the one defined before replaces it, as the dev server does when a module changes. See renderToString().

order.title: Before anything else
order.body: In the entry of the server, the polyfill and the server DOM come first, the modules of Xaendar afterwards.
